channel.title: daysetta blog
channel.description: Stories from building DaySetta: the real macOS desktop on ARM Linux, no VM.

item.title: The boot hang was a scheduler bug
item.description: Most boots stalled before login. An A/B swap of one binary pointed at the exact function, and the fix was a single condition.

item.title: Chasing a black screen
item.description: Login completes, every desktop agent runs, and every frame is black. Five rounds of digging later, the pixels turn out to never have been lost.
